description.value: Vera's Burger Shack is a Vancouver burger chain that hand-presses every patty from 100% fresh Canadian beef and prepares all food to order. The Davie Street location in the West End sits in a cycling-friendly neighbourhood and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. It is a late-night option for cyclists looking for a substantial meal after a long day on the road.
